verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a bulk data export feature in open/portable formats, nor any documented account-deletion/data-portability workflow; the API/MCP evidence is about querying and updating data via Navan's own service, not exporting a full personal data archive to leave the platform. Missing for 10: documented data export/portability feature, evidence of open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk export, and account closure/data takeout process.
